notes: Redesigns the community sound library with filters, playback and downloads, and refreshes its sound collection.
On macOS, opens a selected sound in DingDong for confirmation before installation. Settings also supports installed-status filters and lookup by submission link.
Distinguishes Claude Desktop from Claude Code in Agent activity and adds optional configurations for additional Agent clients.
Uses reminder-colored borders only for unread Agent notifications while keeping reminder icons colored.
Restricts shared client MCP configurations to resources allowed for all clients and warns when authentication is unsupported.

en: Redesigns the community sound library with filters, playback and downloads, and refreshes its sound collection.
On macOS, opens a selected sound in DingDong for confirmation before installation. Settings also supports installed-status filters and lookup by submission link.
Distinguishes Claude Desktop from Claude Code in Agent activity and adds optional configurations for additional Agent clients.
Uses reminder-colored borders only for unread Agent notifications while keeping reminder icons colored.
Restricts shared client MCP configurations to resources allowed for all clients and warns when authentication is unsupported.
zh: 重新设计社区声音库，支持筛选、试听和下载，并更新声音素材。
在 macOS 可从网页打开 DingDong，确认后安装声音；设置中支持按安装状态筛选及通过投稿链接查找。
在 Agent 动态中区分 Claude Desktop 与 Claude Code，并增加其他 Agent 客户端的可选接入配置。
最近 Agent 通知仅在未读时使用提醒颜色的边框，图标始终保留提醒颜色。
共用客户端配置的 MCP 只同步所有相关客户端均允许的资源，并提示不受支持的认证方式。
es: Rediseña la biblioteca de sonidos de la comunidad con filtros, escucha y descargas, y actualiza su colección.
En macOS, abre el sonido en DingDong para confirmarlo antes de instalarlo. Ajustes permite filtrar por estado de instalación y buscar por enlace de envío.
Distingue Claude Desktop de Claude Code en la actividad de Agents y añade configuraciones opcionales para otros clientes.
Aplica el color del recordatorio al borde solo cuando la notificación no se ha leído y conserva el color del icono.
Sincroniza en configuraciones MCP compartidas solo los recursos permitidos para todos los clientes y avisa si la autenticación no es compatible.
